question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:

• Now, the blank 2 refers to both the Greek words which were combined and which in result formed the word "Democracy."
 
• Thus, among the given options the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "words."
 
 
• 
 A word is a sound or letter or group of sounds or letters that expresses a particular meaning. (शब्‍द, लफ़्ज़, पद)

 
 
• 
 Example: I had no words to describe my feelings that day.
